name: Middlesex County, MA
findings: Middlesex County has 7,415 nonprofit organizations. 2,649 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2,219 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Middlesex County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
